(()=>{window.__avisos=[];const re=/N[ãa]o foi poss[ií]vel|erro|Tente novamente|indispon[ií]vel/i;const chk=(t)=>{t=(t||'').trim();const m=t&&t.match(new RegExp('[^]{0,40}('+re.source+')[^]{0,40}','i'));if(m&&window.__avisos.length<10)window.__avisos.push(m[0].replace(/[\n\r\t ]+/g,' '))};new MutationObserver(ms=>{for(const m of ms){m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>chk(n.textContent));if(m.type==='characterData')chk(m.target.textContent)}}).observe(document.body,{childList:true,subtree:true,characterData:true});chk(document.body.innerText);setInterval(()=>{const f=document.querySelector('section[aria-label^="Lembrete da trilha"]');const e=[...document.querySelectorAll('div.fixed')].some(x=>getComputedStyle(x).backgroundColor==='rgb(17, 17, 17)');if((f||e)&&window.__avisos.length<10&&!window.__avisos.includes('TRILHA DOMIFLIX'))window.__avisos.push('TRILHA DOMIFLIX')},300);return 1})()
